October 3, 2022 – Expel , the managed security provider that aims to make security easy to understand, use and improve, today announced that it has increased its Series E funding round , led by Alphabet’s independent growth fund CapitalG and Paladin Capital Group to $171.3 million. groups.note: On 2026-10-24, corrected source TR-xage-1 from INDEPENDENT to OFFICIAL because Yahoo Finance labels it a paid Xage Security release with a GlobeNewswire dateline. original.title: Xage Security hits record growth
original.excerpt: Xage Security reported 81% year-over-year revenue growth and 102% year-over-year customer growth, a 50% rise in net-new revenue between Q3 and Q4 2025, and over 100% growth in net-new revenue from Q4 2025 into Q1 2026 (unaudited, no absolute dollar revenue figure disclosed). The company also closed a $15 million equity round led by Piva Capital in December 2025.
original.limitations: Trade-press relay of company-stated figures; not independently confirmed against a direct Xage or Piva Capital primary release, though an SEC Form D filed the same date (2026-03-18) is consistent with a Reg D raise around this period.

proposedValue.title: Xage Security hits record growth
proposedValue.excerpt: Xage Security reported 81% year-over-year revenue growth and 102% year-over-year customer growth, a 50% rise in net-new revenue between Q3 and Q4 2025, and over 100% growth in net-new revenue from Q4 2025 into Q1 2026 (unaudited, no absolute dollar revenue figure disclosed).
